page.overview:
Who is Amargasaurus?

("La Amarga lizard") is a genus of dicraeosaurid sauropod dinosaur from the Early Cretaceous period of Argentina and measuring up to 10 meters (33 feet) long. A distinctive feature of this dinosaur are the a pair of parallel rows of tall spines down its neck and back, taller than in any other known sauropod. It is an example of Convergent Evolution; with thyreophoran-like, almost spinosaurian dorsal, cervical, and caudal vertebral spines.

In 2022, recent analyses have shown that Amargasaurus is unlikely to have had sails in life, due to it restricting its neck movement.

Amargasaurus was featured in the Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia.

Amargasaurus appears in concept art for the 2015 Jurassic Park arcade game but does not appear in the final game itself.
